title: Superstition unveiled
author: Charles Southwell

authorInfo.bio: Charles Southwell (1814–1860) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Superstition Unveiled" by Charles Southwell is a philosophical treatise written in the mid-19th century. The work critically examines the connection between religious beliefs and political practices, arguing that superstition impedes social and political progress.
